scaleBeatText: 📺 CONTEST: The Long Odds. Dice against the house champion — a smug alien who has never lost on camera. The dice are fair. The stakes are the game. Raise, hold, or walk — but the table is unavoidable.

Nobody's beaten Vex on camera. The veterans just say "don't think at the table." They won't say why.
📺 The last roll. Everything staked is in the middle of the table, and the dice are in your hand.
🚶 Haven walks from the table cleanly — no blades, no hard words. The bond ends where it stood, honestly.

📯 Emberhold's court summons Haven's speaker. SWEAR the oath of the realm (a gift seals it), SERVE at their court (seven days of your speaker's life), or WALK — break the link and stay a free fire, refusing the scale itself with it (the offer does not return). Or REFUSE the scale itself — stay a free fire at regional, whatever that costs. The System will not offer twice.
A sequence of foods on the table. Eat them in the right order.
